purpose: Locate the first complete-request difference on common prior history, determine whether a different task choice exists at identical callback input in that turn, and observe the selected candidate unit's official requested/effective action and atomic status if uniquely matchable.
inference_boundary: Simultaneous same-input choice and complete-request differences are an observed linkage, not proof that that choice alone caused the full request or any financial outcome. budget: One attempt reads exactly two fixed replays and two fixed traces, once per file, at most 128 MiB compressed and 1 GiB decoded. stop: Identity mismatch, budget exhaustion, official replay or receipt failure stops this stage; preserve partial counts and unknown work, never retry or add games under this registration.
interpretation: This pair was selected after economic outcomes were known. Results are post-hoc descriptive evidence, not an independent holdout, a statistical performance estimate or a decomposition of net-profit causation.
